example_text: Dear Customer, Rs.2,500.00 debited from A/c XX1234 on 12-Aug-26 to VPA merchant@okaxis. UPI Ref No 123456789012. If not done by you, call 1800-XXX-XXXX.
why_legit: No link to click, references specific masked account number and UPI reference ID, provides an official toll-free number rather than asking to click anything.
source_citation: Standard bank transaction alert format used by NPCI-linked banks

example_text: Your Amazon order #402-1234567 is out for delivery and will arrive today by 8 PM. Track: amazon.in/orders
why_legit: Uses official domain (amazon.in), no fee requested, no urgency/threat language, references a specific order number.

example_text: 123456 is your OTP for login to XYZ Bank NetBanking. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone including bank staff.
why_legit: Explicitly warns not to share the OTP with anyone, including bank staff, which is the standard official format; contains no links or payment requests.

example_text: Hi, this is HR from TechCorp Pvt Ltd. Thank you for applying for the Software Engineer role. We would like to schedule a technical interview on Monday at 3 PM via Google Meet. Please confirm your availability.
why_legit: No payment requested, uses company's real name and formal process, interview conducted via standard platform, no urgency pressure.

example_text: Reminder: Please complete your periodic KYC update by visiting your nearest XYZ Bank branch or logging into the official XYZ Bank mobile app before 30-Sep-2026.
why_legit: Directs to official branch or official app rather than an external link, gives a reasonable deadline rather than hours, no threat of immediate account freeze.
